title: Act: Emit transitionTo from handleAction when currentScene changes
summary: Compare currentScene before and after game.act
description: Extend handleAction (added by the interact Act) to read the store scene id before and after and emit transitionTo on change.
acceptance_criteria: Given a changed currentScene, when handleAction runs, then transitionTo is emitted with it
Given no change, when it runs, then no transitionTo

steps.action: Read const before = useGameStore.getState().state.currentScene before game.act, and after the playAnimation emit read const after the same way; when after !== before emit reactToPhaser.emit('transitionTo', { sceneId: after }).
steps.code: const before = useGameStore.getState().state.currentScene; game.act(objectId, actionId); reactToPhaser.emit('playAnimation', { target: 'boy', name: 'interact' }); const after = useGameStore.getState().state.currentScene; if (after !== before) reactToPhaser.emit('transitionTo', { sceneId: after });
steps.expected: transitionTo emitted only on a scene change
